# ── ORCHESTRATION (LangGraph) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STATUS: declared + installed, but NOT YET WIRED INTO src/.
#
# ⚠️ CONFLICT WITH PROJECT_GOALS.md §9 "Non-Goals":
#    - "Generic LLM wrapper"      -> LangGraph is one
#    - "Single-turn QA"           -> LangGraph is a stateful graph engine
#    - "Global mutable state"     -> langgraph-checkpoint implies persistence
#
# The project already ships a hand-rolled orchestrator:
#    src/controller/agent.py           (loop + _decide_next_action)
#    src/controller/policy_engine.py   (routing)
#    src/controller/confidence_engine.py
#    src/controller/agent_state.py
#
# Wiring LangGraph in means TWO orchestrators competing for control, which is
# an architecture redesign — outside the Phase A–J scope.
# It is declared here for isolated evaluation only. Do not import it in src/
# without an explicit decision record.
#
# See: results/metrics/fase_j_confidence_dataset_architecture.md
langgraph==1.2.12

uvicorn==0.54.0
httpx==0.28.1
python-multipart==0.0.32

# numpy 2.5.3 on Python 3.14: `numpy.fft` raises
#   ImportError: cannot load module more than once per process
# when 2+ test modules load it in one pytest process. Same class of bug as the
# protobuf upb issue that src/_compat.py works around.
# Affected: tests/test_qdrant_store.py, tests/test_semantic_chunker.py
# Workaround: run those files in separate pytest processes.
